objective: Make the scope inference treat .claude/settings.local.json as repository-controlled when any tracked top-level entry is the same folder as .claude by identity, so a committed folder name that the file system folds onto .claude cannot steer a bare setup to local scope.
scope: Security finding (assignment-0mw8s8hov-9jat): packages/runtime/src/setup/scope.ts:208-226 lists the index only under the pathspec :(icase,literal).claude, which folds ASCII case only. A committed folder named '.claude.', '.claude ' (trailing space), a name with an HFS+ ignorable code point, or a Windows 8.3 short name such as CLAUDE~1 can fold onto the user's .claude on checkout; git ls-files then returns no entry, the identity loop added in 3869116 never runs, and installedScope infers local (scope.ts:258-259).

Fix as the reviewer proposed: list the tracked paths of the work tree (git ls-files --cached -z, limited to the work tree root's own entries), take the distinct first path components, and compare each component's lstat identity (dev and ino as bigint, as 3869116 does for files) with the identity of the .claude folder; a match means the repository controls .claude, so the local file is treated as tracked and inference stays at user. Keep the existing name and file-identity checks. Keep the cost bounded: stat each distinct top-level component once, with early exit on a match.

Add a regression test that fails without the change: a tracked top-level folder that is the same folder as .claude by identity (for example a symlinked or bind-style alias the test can create portably; if only a hard-linked directory would do and that is impossible, use a directory symlink committed as a tracked folder entry or another construction whose lstat identity equals .claude, and state which construction you used and why) never infers local; an ordinary repository with an untracked local file still infers local.
constraints: Before anything else, run `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in your worktree, because node_modules is not shared between worktrees; the prepare step installing lefthook hooks is expected.
Make no git writes (no commit, add, checkout, stash, branch) and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; the root commits. Report your changed paths.

Follow the repository rules in .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md of the worktree: Effect for effects and errors with tagged errors (no try/catch, new Promise, Promise statics or async functions in runtime and CLI source), Effect Schema at data boundaries with onExcessProperty error, Bun APIs and the Bun Shell, JSDoc on every exported function and type.
Testing is unit tests and recorded or synthesized fixtures only: never start pi, a Pi session, T3 Code or a Kimi request.

Gates, run in your worktree: `bunx --no-install mise run build` (commit-ready generated output; the tree must have no unexplained changes after it) and `bunx --no-install mise run verify` (type-check, lint, format check, tests) must exit 0. Give the command, exit code and test counts.

Write `git diff` of your change (after the build) to a file outside the repository in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad and give its path as diff-file evidence.
Build only what the Assignment asks; name any further improvement in the report instead of adding it.
Report in under 400 words; put long logs in a file in the scratchpad above and give its path.
Keep the current error behaviour: a git failure still produces the existing notice and keeps user scope.

criteria.text: A tracked top-level entry that is the same folder as .claude by identity never infers local, with a test that fails without the change
An ordinary untracked local file in a git work tree still infers local, and every existing scope test passes
mise run build leaves no unexplained changes and mise run verify exits 0
The change stays inside the Assignment scope and ownership paths
